definitions.explanation: The school subject covering geography, history, civics, and economics in elementary and junior high school. In senior high school the same ground is divided into separate geography-history and civics subjects.

examples.japanese: {社会科|しゃかいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
{社会科|しゃかいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We visited a factory for social studies class.

examples.japanese: {社会科|しゃかいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国々|くにぐに}→国々：04806_kuniguni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The social studies teacher told us about the countries of the world using a map.

notes:
USAGE:
- One of the core school subjects, alongside ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧, ⟦{算数|さんすう}→算数：04170_sansuu⟧, and ⟦{理科|りか}→理科：03994_rika⟧. In everyday school talk the subject is often just ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (a social studies test).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社会科|しゃかいか}⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧: a class field trip to a factory or public facility
- {社会科|しゃかいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧: a social studies textbook
